import pandas as pd
trips = tables['trips']
pier = tables['pier']
climate = tables['climate']

# daily fleet yt/angler by class and season across both seasons, for classes that matter
df = trips.copy()
df['ypa'] = df['yt']
daily = df.groupby(['fished_date_season','fished_date_doy','cls']).agg(yt=('yt','sum'), anglers=('anglers','sum')).reset_index()
daily['ypa'] = daily['yt']/daily['anglers']

# find bloom windows: for each season, for day_1_5 and three_quarter and overnight, first doy where 3-day rolling ypa >= 0.25
out = []
for season in [1,2]:
    for cls in ['day_1_5','three_quarter','overnight','hd_am','hd_pm']:
        sub = daily[(daily.fished_date_season==season)&(daily.cls==cls)].sort_values('fished_date_doy')
        sub = sub.set_index('fished_date_doy')['ypa']
        if len(sub)==0: continue
        roll = sub.rolling(3, min_periods=2).mean()
        hot = roll[roll>=0.25]
        first_hot = hot.index.min() if len(hot)>0 else None
        out.append((season, cls, first_hot, sub.max(), sub.idxmax()))
result = pd.DataFrame(out, columns=['season','cls','first_doy_roll3_ge_0.25','max_ypa','doy_of_max'])
print(result.to_string())
